3. Check whether this lane has `considerthese/`; if it does, name the newest still-unimplemented proposal and whether it bears on this round.
4. Cross-lane pattern: find two sibling lanes' counters that enforce a *carrier- or oracle-blind* arm (or an isolation control) and quote the pattern this lane should borrow, with paths.
